text_block_list.text:
In the morning, upon arriving at the 
school gates—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, it's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mooorniiing! The weather is absolute 
perfection today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I have a super, duuuper important test 
after this! If I fail, I'll definitely 
have to take remedial classes~!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I did try my best to study, but I've got 
zero confidence, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And then, my racing silks!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
See, just wearing a racing outfit makes 
you feel like you can win any race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So if I take the test in this outfit... 
I'm suuuuure to get an aaaaamazing score!!

"...With this much confidence, she'd 
certainly get a good score right now. 
Though I get the feeling the teacher might 
get mad at her..."
choice_data_list:
Let's be persistent and persuade our 
teacher together!
I quickly have them change clothes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, what, what, what?! Trainer, you're 
coming with me?!

"Since it would be bad if she had to take 
remedial classes, I told her I'd count on 
the power of her racing outfit and help 
persuade the teacher as her Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you'll be watching over me 
during my test...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no doubt we got a perfect 
score! Yaaaaaaay!!
choice_data_list:
(She's got the wrong idea about 
something…)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's head to the classroom 
right away! Ehehe, it kinda feels like 
parents' observation day~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Teacherrrrrrrr!! I brought the Trainer 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why? Wait, why are you in your racing 
gear!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm gonna get a perfect score!

After that, I somehow persuaded the 
teacher to permit her to wear her racing 
racewear, and as a result—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—N-No way, seriously...!? Winning Ticket, 
who's always barely scraping past failing 
grades—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
A-A hundred points...!? Even if it's just 
a quiz, h-how could this...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we did it, we did it--!! A 
hundred pointssss~~♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Racewear power really is incredible, huh?! 
I'm sooooo happy!

"...Winning Ticket was overjoyed, but the 
teacher, terrified by the sheer intensity 
of her power of delusion, banned her from 
wearing her racing silks from then on."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~~~?! Why do I have to change 
clothes~~~~?!
choice_data_list: Trainer's gonna be mad at you for that.
Trainer's gonna be mad at you for that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Is that truuueee!? I really don't want 
that to happen~~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I hate supplementary lessons even 
more... Ugh, so I really can't rely on the 
power of my racewear, huh~?”
choice_data_list: You might get better results in uniform

text_block_list.text:
If she wears the uniform she's used to, it 
might help her recall what happened during 
class. When I mention this...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: UWWWAAAAAAAHHHH!! I'M ZO ZORRRYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Even though we always, always studied 
together...! Even though she worked so 
hard alongside me...!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And to think I was going to throw away 
that uniform... and betray everyone, 
waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever betray our uniform again! 
We're gonna conquer this test 
togetheeeer~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Trainer, thank you for helping 
me realize it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me, my uniform! I'm coming to 
pick you up right now~~~~!!

...At any rate, Winning Ticket changed 
into her school uniform, took the test, 
and as a result... well, she managed to 
avoid supplementary lessons for now!
